title: A worker's brief states code.md's rule against calling another module's underscore names when its touches name tool code
goal: the brief of an item whose touches name _tools/ files states that another module never calls a name that starts with an underscore and that a needed helper is added as a public name in the module that owns it; the brief of an item whose touches name no _tools/ file does not state it

run:
import subprocess,sys
out=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','brief','ST-525ypepb'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
ph='never calls a name that ' + 'starts with an underscore'
ok=(ph in out)==True
print('brief of ST-525ypepb has: '+ph if ok else 'brief of ST-525ypepb: want phrase present: '+ph)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import subprocess,sys
out=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','brief','ST-uh7kxean'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
ph='never calls a name that ' + 'starts with an underscore'
ok=(ph in out)==False
print('brief of ST-uh7kxean lacks: '+ph if ok else 'brief of ST-uh7kxean: want phrase absent: '+ph)
